rows.grounds: compound locative; installation of a movable liṅga
compound; valid for all places and times

items.question: What scope of place and time governs movable liṅga installation and initiation?
premises: The context includes installation of a movable liṅga.
These contexts are qualified as applicable in all places and times.
items.inference: Movable liṅga installation and initiation are not restricted by place or time.
uncertainties: The predicate governing these contexts is implicit from the preceding verses.
items.plain_english: In the installation of a movable liṅga and in initiation, the provisions apply in all places and at all times.
